_doc: Equippables a quest waits for without taking them, which players wear or hold off the main inventory (armour, off hand, Curios).
FTB's item task counts only the 36 main slots, so tools/quest_engine.py carried_task emits entrelumen:carried_item for a non-consuming task on one of these (F25).

items.entrelumen:heliodor_compass: Heliodor Compass, often in the off hand (guide_entrelumen_start, guide_entrelumen_compass, guide_entrelumen_atlas)
